content: A single conversation with a wise person is worth more than ten years of solitary study.
author: Chinese Proverbs
sourceWork: Ting jun yi xi hua, sheng du shi nian shu (听君一席话，胜读十年书)
explanation: Books and manuscripts contain valuable theory, but a genuine master embodies wisdom in their breathing presence, gestures, and tone. A single hour in the presence of an elder who has lived through fire and emerged with peace can shatter illusions that decades of solitary reading could never dislodge.
practicalInsight: Reach out to a respected elder or seasoned mentor this week and ask them what life has taught them about endurance.
reflectionPrompt: Whose lived wisdom could you seek out right now to illuminate a path you are struggling to walk alone?
